entities.name: UniProt P91133 UBR-1
observations: Reviewed Caenorhabditis elegans E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase UBR-1; submitted 768-aa sequence is an exact 100% identity match across its length to a segment of the 2,058-aa protein.

UBR-1 is annotated as an N-end-rule pathway E3 that recognizes proteins with destabilizing N-terminal residues and promotes ubiquitination and degradation; N-end-rule function is annotated by similarity.

Full-protein annotations include cytoplasm and membrane localization, ubiquitin ligase complex, and single-pass membrane protein; these localizations were not established specifically for the submitted fragment.

C. elegans-specific reported roles include CED-3-dependent LIN-28 degradation in seam-cell fate patterning and negative regulation of glutamate metabolism via GOT-1.2, associated with backward locomotion regulation.
